Package me.manossef.api.alexandria.commands

Class ReloadConfigCommand

  • java.lang.Object
    • me.manossef.api.alexandria.commands.ReloadConfigCommand
  • public final class ReloadConfigCommand
extends java.lang.Object
    Houses the implementation of a basic command that reloads a plugin's configuration files.

    • Method Detail

      • executor

        public static org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor executor​(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin plugin)
        Returns a command executor for a basic command that reloads the provided plugin's config.yml file. The command is named after the plugin and takes reload as its first argument, which is required for the configuration file to be reloaded.
        Parameters:
        plugin - The plugin to create the command executor for.
        Returns:
        A command executor for a basic configuration reloading command.

      • executor

        public static org.bukkit.command.CommandExecutor executor​(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin plugin,
                                                          java.util.function.Consumer<org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin> reloadFunction)
        Returns a command executor for a basic command that runs the provided function on the provided plugin. The intention is that the function should reload some configuration file used by the plugin. The command is named after the plugin and takes reload as its first argument, which is required for the function to be run.
        Parameters:
        plugin - The plugin to create the command executor for.
        reloadFunction - The function the command runs on the plugin.
        Returns:
        A command executor for a basic configuration reloading command.

      • tabCompleter

        public static org.bukkit.command.TabCompleter tabCompleter()
        Returns a tab completer that tab completes reload for the first argument. This tab completer is meant to be used for commands with executors created using executor(Plugin) or executor(Plugin, Consumer).
        Returns:
        A tab completer that tab completes reload for the first argument.

      • setupCommand

        public static void setupCommand​(org.bukkit.command.PluginCommand command)
        Sets the provided plugin command's executor to one created using executor(Plugin), and its tab completer to the one returned by tabCompleter().
        Parameters:
        command - The command to set up.
